newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates end down at 20.875/21.125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates end down at 20.875/21.125 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates ended lower on Tuesday on a very liquid market, dealers said.
Rates ended at 20.875/21.125 percent after opening at 21.25, following Monday's close of 21.375 percent.

"The market is very liquid at the moment," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank, adding that with a new reserve period starting last weekend, there were now no domestic factors likely to reduce the abundance of funds.
